pp2.7:1.1: puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hoti?
pp2.7:1.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakālakehi akusalehi dhammehi,
pp2.7:1.3: evaṃ puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo va hoti.
pp2.7:2.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhākusalesu dhammesu, ummujjati sāhuhirikusalesu dhammesu, ummujjati sāhu-ottappakusalesu dhammesu, ummujjati sāhuviriyakusalesu dhammesu, ummujjati sāhu paññākusalesu dhammesū ti:
pp2.7:2.3: tassa sā saddhā n' eva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyati c' eva, tassa sā hirī n' eva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyati c' eva, tassa taṃ ottappaṃ n' eva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyati c' eva, tassa taṃ viriyaṃ n' eva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyati c' eva, tassa sā paññā n' eva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati hāyati c' eva:
pp2.7:3.1: Kathañ ca puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti?
pp2.7:3.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhā . . . pe . . . -paññā kusalesu dhammesū ti,
pp2.7:3.3: tassa sā saddhā n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti, tassa sā hirī n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti, tassa taṃ ottappaṃ n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti, tassa taṃ viriyaṃ n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti tassa sā paññā n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti tassa sā pañña n' eva hāyati no vaḍḍhati ṭhito hoti:
pp2.7:4.1: Kathañ ca puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi?
pp2.7:4.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhā . . . pe . . . paññā kusalesu dhammesū ti,
pp2.7:4.3: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanāmaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano,
pp2.7:5.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhā . . . pe . . . -paññā kusalesu dhammesū ti,
pp2.7:5.3: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgamī hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antakaro hoti:
pp2.7:6.1: Kathañ ca puggalo ummujjitvā paṭigādhappatto hoti?
pp2.7:6.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhā . . . pe . . . -paññā kusalesu dhammesū ti,
pp2.7:6.3: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyāmaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha-parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā:
pp2.7:7.1: Kathañ ca puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāraṅgato phale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo?
pp2.7:7.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo ummujjati sāhusaddhā . . . pe . . . -paññā kusalesu khammesū ti,
pp2.7:7.3: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃcetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati:
pp2.7:7.4: evaṃ puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāraṅgato phale teṭṭhati brāhmaṇo. 2.
pp2.7:8.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo aṭṭha vimokkhe kāyena phusitvā, paññāya c' assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti:
pp2.7:14.2: Yassa puggalassa sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa saddhindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, saddhāvāhiṃ saddhā-pubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti:
pp2.7:14.4: Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo saddhānusārī phale ṭhito saddhāvimutto
